name: Extra Defensive Power
body:
You have unlocked a new ability to use while in your defensive stance.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive power class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional defensive power. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this defensive power.

Special: You can gain Extra Defensive Power multiple times.
